lead: VVS Laxman has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 1 November 1974 in Hyderabad.
As of 2026, he is 51 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Hyderabad cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
This profile collects the VVS facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: VVS Laxman — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: VVS Laxman was born on 1 November 1974 in Hyderabad, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at Little Flower High School, Hyderabad.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu and English.

sections.heading: VVS Laxman — Career and Professional Work
paras: VVS Laxman works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, VVS has been associated with India national cricket team (from 1996 to 2012), Hyderabad cricket team (from 1992), Deccan Chargers (from 2008 to 2010), Lancashire County Cricket Club (from 2009 to 2009) and Kochi Tuskers Kerala (from 2011 to 2011).
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
